verdict.rationale: Codegen's Slack integration is documented to 'send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress' directly in team channels, which covers both task completion and requests for input. Issue-tracker status updates and comments (Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Monday.com) and a resume-paused-run API add further signals and a way to act on them. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring notification triggers (e.g. on completion vs. awaiting input), non-Slack channels such as webhooks, email or push, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
